text:
alex: quick q 1 Dedicated Pool creation form  inline errors or a top summary on submit? i prototyped both.
priya: inline. tiny form, people usually fix one field and re-submit.
noah: inline wins devwise (formik validators). we can auto-focus first invalid field.
tara: but when multiple fields fail (min>max, missing billing tag, invalid name) a small banner on submit that says e.g. "3 errors  view details" would help.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: ensure aria-live announces count and focus moves to first invalid control. provide a skip link to errors for keyboard users.
alex: required markers  asterisk vs explicit "Required" label. product wants explicit in some audited flows.
priya: compromise: asterisk on desktop, show tiny "Required" under label on mobile. reserve vertical space to avoid layout jumps.
noah: dev note: reserve 16px under labels so showing the word doesn't shift layout.
tara: destructive copy on pool page: current modal asks to type "delete pool". propose stronger copy: "Delete pool and all cached artifacts  irreversible" require full pool name + checkbox "I understand charges may persist".
a11y-bot: use role=alertdialog, focus trap, and link confirmation input to consequence text via aria-describedby. make CTA text explicit: "Delete pool" and critical color.
alex: consensus? inline field errors + compact banner on submit with a small in-page list linking to each error; asterisk on desktop, explicit "Required" on mobile; destructive modal explicit copy + typed-name + checkbox + alertdialog.
priya: sounds good  i'll update Figma and do a small PR for formik onSubmit. tag me for copy review.
noah: i'll add the aria-live region and keyboard anchors in the PR.
a11y-bot: recommended checklist: aria-live, first-invalid focus, alertdialog role, anchors keyboard focusable, color contrast checks.
tara: thanks everyone, will post PR + fig link when ready :thumbsup:
